evidence.note: Matches the AADSTS75016 symptom after the admin changed the claim. Every other check passed, including the signature, audience, recipient, time window and attributes.

output.fix: In the Entra enterprise application, open Single sign-on, then Attributes & Claims, then the Unique User Identifier (Name ID) claim. Map it to a populated source attribute, such as user.mail or the user principal name. Set the Name identifier format to Email address (urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:emailAddress) to match the SP. Make sure the source attribute is filled in for the test user. The admin's change probably removed it or pointed it at an empty attribute, and it can also happen if the format was changed without a matching source. Keep the Assertion signed and keep validating against the configured IdP certificate. Then capture a new response and re-run the validation.
